title: Verification
intro: Inmolink checks every agency before it can share listings with the network, publish them or connect a website. Upload documents that prove your company, then send them to our team.
verifiedBody: Your agency is verified. You can share and publish listings and create website API keys.
onboardingFirst: Complete your company details first, then come back to send them for verification.

upload.title: Upload a document
upload.file: File (PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB)

submit.title: Send for verification
submit.body: Our team reviews the company details on your onboarding page together with these documents. If you change your details after sending, the review starts from your latest details.

notices.submitted: Sent. We will email you when our team has decided.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only an agency admin can manage verification.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Your company details changed meanwhile. Reload the page and send again.
errors.VERIFICATION_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: Your documents are already waiting for review.
errors.VERIFICATION_DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED: Upload at least one document first.
errors.DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: That file is not a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.DOCUMENT_LIMIT_REACHED: You can upload up to 10 documents. Remove one first.
errors.DOCUMENT_LOCKED: Documents already sent cannot be removed.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please choose a document type and a file.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many uploads. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

approved.subject: {agency} is verified on Inmolink
approved.body: Our team has verified {agency}. You can now share listings with the network, publish them and connect your website.
approved.footer: You receive this email as an admin of {agency}.

rejected.subject: Verification of {agency}: action needed
rejected.body: Our team could not verify {agency} yet. Their note: {reason}
rejected.footer: You receive this email as an admin of {agency}.
